outcome: Neonatal mortality attributed to asphyxia, anoxia, or trauma
cohort: 6,054,536 liveborn singleton births in NHS hospitals in England from 2005 to 2014
finding: There was no significant difference in the odds of neonatal mortality outside of working hours compared with working hours for spontaneous births or instrumental births, but a small increased risk of mortality was observed for emergency Cesarean sections without labor outside of working hours.
mod_finding: Higher odds of neonatal mortality attributed to asphyxia, anoxia, or trauma were observed out of hours for emergency Cesareans without labor.
